evbug.qemu_model: software input handler; no dedicated QEMU device
evbug.scope: Linux evbug input-handler behavior and real Asterinas input integration: registration, existing and future device connections, event diagnostics, disconnect and handler lifetime. Preserve source obligations even outside the public SYN/KEY/REL scenarios. Physical input IRQ, full event families, allocation failures and concurrency are not fully covered by the fixed public suite.
evbug.target_baseline: original upstream target without this driver; no previously translated Rust candidate

ne2k-pci.scope: Linux PCI NE2000 / QEMU RTL8029 (10ec:8029) and shared 8390 behavior: real PCI registration, PROM MAC, PIO buffer ownership, interrupt progress, transmit/receive, stop/start and recovery. Preserve source obligations, not only the fixed wire exchanges. ISA/PCMCIA, physical clones, dynamic hotplug, complete TCP/IP and exhaustive fault/concurrency coverage are excluded from public validation claims.
ne2k-pci.target_baseline: original upstream target without this driver; no previously translated Rust candidate
